XData.name: UrlMap
XData.Data: <Routes> <!-- <Route Url="/class/:namespace/:classname" Method="GET" Call="invokeGetService" Cors="true"/> <Map Prefix="/docserver" Forward="%Api.v1.DocServer"/> --> <Route Url="/deathDatePost" Method="POST" Call="invokePostService"/> <Route Url="/alertdoc" Method="POST" Call="AlertDoc" /> </Routes>

Method.name: invokePostService
AlertDoc
Method.Implementation:
w 1,! #dim %request AS %CSP.Request
// Make Dynamic Object From Request set content = ##class(%DynamicObject).%FromJSON(%request.Content)
w 2,!
set tSC = ##class(Ens.Director).CreateBusinessService("POSTService", .svc)
w 3,!
do svc.OnProcessInput(content,.tResponse)
w 4,!
set tSC = ##class(Ens.Util.JSON).ObjectToJSONStream(tResponse,.tStream)
w 5,!
write tStream.Read()
quit 1
